name: Triad Fastener LP

about:
Triad Fastener LP operates from Alda, Nebraska, a location just off Interstate 80 that the company says provides reliable transportation and a steady labor pool for its Midwest customer base. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company runs a clean, modern facility housing 19 injection molding machines with clamp capacities from 60 to 650 tons. Its core processes include two-shot molding, gas-assist molding, two-color molding, horizontal insert molding, and elastomeric over-molding. In-house capabilities extend to mold design, service, and repair; a quality lab with CMM documentation; rapid prototyping via fused deposition modeling and soft tooling; and secondary operations such as machining, assembly, sonic welding, pad printing, hot stamping, specialty packaging, and kitting. Automated assembly and inspection cells support production consistency.

Triad Fastener serves customers across the Midwest with custom injection molding services and also markets proprietary product lines, notably the DamGates® brand, through its sister company Triad Products. Specific industry sectors are not detailed in public materials.

The company emphasizes its practice of Scientific Molding principles to establish robust, repeatable processes that minimize cost and quality issues. It also highlights ongoing automation investments to reduce labor costs and improve process consistency, positioning these approaches as key differentiators.
